courses.name: Ken McDonald Golf Course
courses.notes: Platform migration, not an outage (resolved 2026-07-28). The old tenant playkenmcdonald.totaleintegrated.com still answers Cloudflare 525 — origin SSL dead, not a blip — while the course's own site now links to kenmcdonald.totaleintegrated.net, which served a full sheet (49 slots, $29.60-$40.70, 30-day window) when probed today. Total-e's replacement platform: a shared anonymous JSON gateway (courseco-gateway.totaleintegrated.net) that identifies the club by the Origin header, so the tenant subdomain is the whole id. New courseco adapter. Expect other totale tenants to follow this migration; the old host going dark reads exactly like a dark course from the inside.
